relationship_to_v1.purpose: Resource-constrained primary route evaluating the mapping/integration layer from externally annotated or deterministic reference projections; raw-text end-to-end expert-gold evaluation remains a separate stronger follow-up.

primary_hypothesis.text: Given source-local scientific projections whose tested coordinates are externally human/expert-annotated or deterministically grounded in a published standard, ORION's typed comparison reduces invalid merges relative to a flat predicate/canonicalization baseline without materially increasing false splits versus an exact-coordinate conservative baseline.

scope.reason: Those layers require model/provider or new expert resources. They remain explicitly CANNOT_CHECK rather than being simulated.

gold_authority.coordinate_masking: A coordinate without allowed authority is UNRESOLVED/NOT_EVALUATED; it is never filled by a proxy to increase coverage.
gold_authority.source_text_policy: Do not vendor upstream source text unless its licence explicitly permits redistribution. Store repository/dataset revision, locator and content hash instead.

reference_sources.redistribution: claims/evidence annotations CC-BY-4.0; S2ORC abstracts ODC-By-1.0
USE_UPSTREAM_DATASET_TERMS; do not assume a licence not present in the frozen registry

statistics.confidence: Wilson 95% intervals for rates; paired bootstrap for system differences once final N is frozen
statistics.discipline_analysis: report each upstream/domain stratum separately and pooled
statistics.multiplicity: single primary family; Holm correction across coordinate ablations
statistics.reason_for_one_repeat: The mapping algorithms in this route are deterministic. Random model extraction is outside the primary route.

quality_gates: every expected relation has allowed gold authority with evidence locators
no final gold case contains LLM_PROPOSAL/HEURISTIC_PROXY/SIMULATED/SELF_LABEL authority
all upstream revisions and content hashes are frozen before evaluated-system outputs
case selection is deterministic and outcome-blind
